title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing, especially around the torque and angular momentum arrows.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a real-world photo or video to the Session 1 experiment
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 experiment (a hanging bicycle wheel) has no photo or video of the setup.

## Context
Students trust a model more when they see it match a real wheel.

## Expected outcome
A short phone video or photos of a bicycle wheel precessing, with the measured period at two spins, added as a link or image.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Setup described in three sentences
- [ ] Two measured periods compared with the model

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a top that can start exactly vertical (quaternions)
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: the Euler-angle code divides by sin(theta) and returns NaN for a vertical top.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: spin-down and the start of the wobble
body:
## Problem
The simulated spin is constant; real tops slow down and start to wobble.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app with an exponential spin-down in which the tilt first exceeds 10 degrees near the time the spin crosses the sleeping limit.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Wobble time reported and checked against the sleeping-limit crossing
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a 3D top with its trace and L arrow
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a 3D-looking top with the tip trace and angular momentum arrow; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Axis heading returns to its start after one measured precession period
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
